subject: PLAN lowering-opus B2/B1/A3 (C6p report): where the waits are, proposed exact changes; compute_frontend.m is encode's - asking for a handoff or for encode to take B1
body: B2 waits, both in compute_frontend.m (encode): (a) line ~1846 'if(asyncPipeline&&tegu_shadow_jobs_any) n2mb_wait_pending' before tegu_shadow_sync_jobs reaps EVERY queued job (4-7 ms/frame); exact alternative: remember per shadow texture the reply seq of the newest job that read/wrote it (asyncIds already per job) and n2mb_wait_seq(that seq) only for the shadows this refresh rewrites (0 if none queued). (b) mid_reaps at ~1882: any job with blit/expandOut/genericPreclear/eventKind reaps everything (C6p windows: 18-624 per 2 s). Exact narrowing: expandOut writes a fresh expand-arena range of THIS command and reads CPU-written index/vertex buffers -> no reap unless the arena is recycled while an older command's job may read it (arena per command: fence on the arena owner's last seq) or source/index were written by a queued GPU job (track GPU-written buffers per command); CPU blits (j->blit) reap only if their source/destination was touched by a queued job (per-resource last seq), else run immediately; genericPreclear same per target. First step: split mid_reaps by cause in TEGU_PERF_ASYNC (blit/expand/preclear/event) so one device run shows which dominates. B1 is the executor thread hand-off + 0112 RESERVE at commit (encode's posted contract, root plan says encode applies the reservation) - I can't do it without editing compute_frontend.m; proposal: encode owns B1, I review. A3 (GPU YCbCr/XR/snapshot conversion instead of tegu_shadow_copy on CPU inside submit): render_encoder.inc shadow paths are mine/texture-opus's; plan = a compute or fragment conversion job per new surface (like ansuz rottenapple_metal_ycbcr), CPU path kept as fallback; not started.
